headline: State Bank of Pakistan Annual Report Details Inflation-Driven Rate Hike
summary: The State Bank of Pakistan's annual report revealed a 100 bps rate hike in April after Middle East conflict energy spikes pushed headline inflation to double digits, while net FX reserves hit targets.
why: The SBP sets monetary policy for Pakistan, balancing currency stabilization, external reserves, and double-digit inflation management.

impacts.name: Pakistan Policy Rate
impacts.why: Central bank hiked benchmark policy interest rate by 100 bps to contain energy-driven double-digit inflation.
